_source.title: 获取光线追踪光源配置
_source.remarks.text.0: {@link PCB_RayTracerEngine.getRenderConfigurations | 获取光线追踪渲染配置} 接口中包含一种光源配置，本接口用于获取不同光源配置
_source.remarks.text.1: 本接口配置定义还在进行中

title: Get the ray tracer light configurations
remarks.text.0: The {@link PCB_RayTracerEngine.getRenderConfigurations | get ray tracer render configurations} API contains a light configuration. This API is used to get different light configurations
remarks.text.1: The configuration definition of this API is still in progress
